questions.prompt: Words are written left to right in block capitals and seen in a left-right mirror (a vertical mirror line). In the block capitals used here, exactly these letters look the same in a left-right mirror: A H I M O T U V W X Y. Which word looks exactly the same in the mirror?
questions.solution: A left-right mirror reverses the order of the letters and mirrors each letter. The word looks the same only if it reads the same backward AND every letter is a listed symmetric letter. TOOT is the only choice that does both.

questions.prompt: A 6 by 6 grid has two dashed mirror lines: a vertical one between columns 3 and 4 and a horizontal one between rows 3 and 4. The figure must look the same in BOTH mirrors. Four cells are already shaded in the top-left quarter: (1,1), (1,2), (2,2) and (3,3). Mark every shaded cell of the completed figure, including the four given cells.
questions.solution: Each given cell (r, c) also needs its images (r, 7 - c), (7 - r, c) and (7 - r, 7 - c). That gives 4 x 4 = 16 cells, one copy of the pattern in each quarter.

questions.prompt: Two vertical mirror lines are 3 cells apart: line 1 on the left, line 2 on the right. A shape is reflected in line 1 and the image is then reflected in line 2. Where does the final image end up?

questions.solution: 0, 6, 9 light 6 and 8 lights 7: four digits.
